description: Get a finished Load Test's response times per URL, slowest first by the total time all hits to the URL took: hits, average, minimum and maximum response time, and average time to first byte, in milliseconds. Use it to name the slow pages behind the percentiles in get_load_test_report. Compare urlOffset and the URLs returned against totalUrls to see how much you have not read; page on with offset.

limit.description: How many URLs to return (default 20, maximum 100).

loadTestId.description: The load test id, as reported by list_load_tests.

offset.description: Zero-based index of the first URL to return (default 0).

name: get_load_test_url_timings
title: Get Load Test URL Timings
